**Review: clean (read here; runner build started).** Head b34f04e88. Label: merge-ready. P3 stands (fixes #3019).

What the change does:
- New `seam_tangents` in `lead_fit.rs` gives the lead-in and lead-out tangents. `plan_leads` and `both_fit` both use it, so fitting and planning agree.
- On a closed ring (first point within 1e-6 mm of the last, more than two points), a tangent that turns from the other end's tangent into the material is mirrored across it. The 0.05 degree bend of a fitted corner arc at the seam then points to the air side, and the straight lead stops crossing the cut of its own level.
- Open walks (tab windows, chains, an exit point) and smooth seams keep their tangents. The crossing law itself is unchanged.

Checks I made:
- The mirror is exact for the near-parallel case and changes the direction by twice the bend: the leads stay first-order continuous at the seam.
- The in/out conditions are mirrored in sign (`dot(t1, air_side(t0)) < 0` versus `dot(t0, air_side(t1)) > 0`). I traced this: time reversal flips the arrival side. The mutation record in the body (lead-in mirror out, lead-out mirror out) pins both halves with red cases.
- `both_fit` and `plan_leads` call the same `seam_tangents`; no second reading of the tangents survives.
- New test file `crates/motion/tests/contour_tab_lead.rs`: no `crossed_pairs`, no `Crossing`/`Gouge` from `verify`, and full 8 mm leads, climb and conventional, with and without tabs. The issue's plate is the fixture.
- Decision record `docs/decisions/3019-contour-tab-lead-cross.md` is present. `lead_fit.rs` is 379 lines - inside the 400-line rule.
- No goldens moved; app goldens and verify suites listed green by the author's gate.

Note: this changes posted toolpath geometry (safety floor), so the merge batch gives it a read-only second review at the safety tier before the merge.

Runner: pr-test run 44851610265 started on m3 for this head; the result follows in a later comment.

Run note: pr-test run 44851610265 failed at the head check only - the reviewer dispatched it with a mistaked sha (last digit), no test ran. Re-dispatched correctly as run 44852940029 at head b34f04e88fdbc63936c3f40cccafbee01f10914c; the result follows.
Runner build result: pr-test run 44852940029 on m3 completed **success** (test job green) at head b34f04e88fdbc63936c3f40cccafbee01f10914c. The merge-ready review of this head stands.

- No goldens moved. There is no golden diff to check. No UI files changed.
